[NDBG.1.1] These accessors read the **native Rete** engine's structures. They are
read-only — none mutate engine state. On a backend that does not expose a Rete
network they return `DS_OK` with no results (no callbacks fired, count 0); code
defensively against the empty case rather than assuming a populated network.
`ds_engine_new` gives every engine a Rete network or fails, so a `libds.h` caller
meets neither these no-network answers nor `ds_engine_mem`'s
`DS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED` ([NDBG.2.1]).
